name: Spare the Dying
entries: Choose a creature within range that has 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|XPHB} and isn't dead. The creature becomes {@variantrule Stable|XPHB}.

entriesHigherLevel.name: Cantrip Upgrade
entries: The range doubles when you reach levels 5 (30 feet), 11 (60 feet), and 17 (120 feet).
